statusDetail: Atomic audit completed for the only discoverable page template and a representative missing-route failure state.

page.notes: Single server-rendered stream template. The URL pathname is converted client-side into a media filename. No internal content routes, valid sitemap entries or manifest shortcuts were discoverable.

paths.description: Homepage and sole discoverable stream-player template; covers the first viewport, player, promotional links, preference states, mobile layout, network, accessibility, security and memory.
Representative unknown media identifier used to test routing, HTTP status and failure recovery for the path-derived player.

findings.summary: The palette is fixed dark rather than following the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The DOM and computed-style probe contain no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule; the dark-preference capture uses the same fixed gradients.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and define preference-driven light and dark tokens, using light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme fallback.

findings.summary: Infinite shimmer and glow animations continue when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe reports six running infinite animations and no prefers-reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable the shimmer and glow cycles inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, leaving only essential state feedback.

findings.summary: The UI does not adapt to higher-contrast or forced-color preferences.
findings.evidence: The high-contrast capture is visually unchanged and the stylesheet has no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adjustments that preserve boundaries, text and focus indicators.

findings.summary: The popup state change is hand-animated and has no View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: DOM CSS inspection found opacity and scale transitions but no view-transition-name, ::view-transition rules or startViewTransition call.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a same-document View Transition for the popup state where supported, with the existing transition as fallback.

findings.summary: Playback is designed to trigger new advertising tabs and a full-screen interruption.
findings.evidence: Inline script opens an ad on play, more ads at 10 and 15 seconds, and activates a full-viewport overlay at 10 seconds.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsolicited window.open calls and the timed interstitial. Keep advertising clearly labelled, in-page and non-blocking.

findings.summary: The timed overlay is a custom div with no semantic modal behavior and no genuine dismissal.
findings.evidence: The popup probe shows role and aria-modal are absent, with zero close controls and no Escape or outside-click handler; its only action navigates to an ad.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace it with a dialog only if a modal is necessary, provide close and Escape behavior, restore focus, and do not make dismissal conditional on an ad click.

findings.summary: The primary Telegram target is only 40 CSS pixels high and card focus indicators rely on a thin browser outline.
findings.evidence: The target probe measured the Telegram link at 40px high and card links at a 1px dark auto outline, although mobile reflow itself has no overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase compact targets to at least 44px and add a clear, high-contrast :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: The page does not explain the stream or establish a clear content hierarchy.
findings.evidence: The first viewport has a blank player and promotional links but no heading, description, stream title or context; the document title is only Stream Player.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a visible h1 and concise stream description, then make playback and recovery the primary hierarchy rather than promotions.

findings.summary: The core stream cannot be played at the audited entry URL.
findings.evidence: The page constructs https://cdn2.videy.co/.mp4; HAR records a redirect followed by net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB, while the player remains at 0:00.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate the route before rendering, resolve a valid media URL server-side, and show a safe landing or explicit not-found state when no media identifier exists.

findings.summary: A failed stream leaves a blank player with no error state or recovery action.
findings.evidence: The media element stays at readyState 0/networkState 3 and the page displays no failure text, retry button or route guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Listen for media error and stalled states, announce a useful message, and offer retry or return navigation without losing context.

findings.summary: Render-blocking third-party styles make loading network-sensitive.
findings.evidence: The HAR identifies two parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority styles taking about 3.06 seconds; the trace measured FCP/LCP at 4.56 seconds, despite Lighthouse measuring 2.0 seconds in another run.
findings.suggestedFix: Self-host and subset the required font/icon assets, inline only critical styles, and defer non-critical CSS.

findings.summary: A full icon library is loaded for one visible brand icon.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 18,659 bytes and 99.31 percent of Font Awesome CSS unused; its brand font transfers another 108,759 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the single icon with a small inline SVG and remove the Font Awesome stylesheet and webfont.

findings.summary: The page has no heading structure and the custom modal state has no focus management.
findings.evidence: The semantic probe found zero headings and only a main landmark; the popup has no dialog semantics or close control.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical h1-led structure and implement modal focus entry, containment, Escape dismissal and focus restoration.

findings.summary: Important collection metadata is rendered at 9px.
findings.evidence: DOM CSS and desktop/mobile captures show .sub and .count set to 9px and badges to 8px, below comfortable reading size.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise essential labels to a legible responsive size with adequate line height and reduce nonessential badge density.

findings.summary: The video element provides no caption track or equivalent.
findings.evidence: The media probe found zero track elements; Lighthouse identified the video node for manual caption verification.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide synchronized captions with track kind=captions and an accessible transcript when the media contains speech or meaningful audio.

findings.summary: Search metadata is generic and incomplete.
findings.evidence: The title is Stream Player and there is no meta description; Lighthouse fails the meta-description audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a unique descriptive title and meta description from the media identifier and visible stream metadata.

findings.summary: robots.txt is malformed because an HTML page is appended to the directives.
findings.evidence: Recon received Cloudflare directives followed by the full application HTML; Lighthouse reports 550 robots.txt parse errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a dedicated text/plain robots.txt response only, and keep application fallback routing away from reserved files.

findings.summary: The site emits soft-200 pages and no canonical or real sitemap.
findings.evidence: The canonical probe is empty; /sitemap.xml returns the application HTML and an arbitrary missing route returns HTTP 200 with the same shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Return 404 for unknown media IDs, publish a valid XML sitemap, and emit a canonical URL for each valid media page.

findings.summary: The media page has no structured or share-preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The probe found no JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter Card or preview image metadata for this video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata that matches visible stream data.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but all core security headers are absent.
findings.evidence: The header primitive reports missing CSP, HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options; no cookies or exposed client secrets were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP, HSTS and nosniff at the edge, then verify media and font origins against the allowlist.

findings.summary: The page delegates most bytes to third parties and sends users to opaque ad domains during playback.
findings.evidence: The HAR attributes 162,291 of 172,562 transferred bytes to third parties; source schedules unsolicited windows to apiwebster.com and hai8g.com.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsolicited ad redirects, document necessary third parties, self-host small assets, and apply a strict referrer policy.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are not configured.
findings.evidence: The header primitive found no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy in addition to missing CSP and HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and a minimal Permissions-Policy; add X-Frame-Options only as a legacy complement where needed.

findings.summary: Core media is not progressively enhanced.
findings.evidence: The raw HTML includes source src=https://cdn2.videy.co/.mp4 and JavaScript is required to derive the route-specific URL; the crawler view therefore has labels but no usable stream.
findings.suggestedFix: Render the validated media source and fallback content in server HTML, then enhance controls with JavaScript.

findings.summary: The custom interruption has fragile runtime and accessibility behavior.
findings.evidence: When forced active, the overlay is visible but has no dialog role, close path, Escape handling or outside-click handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the top layer through dialog or popover as appropriate, with deterministic dismissal and focus restoration.

findings.summary: Missing and failed media states are served as successful blank shells.
findings.evidence: An arbitrary missing media route returns HTTP 200, while the homepage media request fails and neither state offers retry or navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return meaningful HTTP status codes and render explicit loading, error, retry and not-found states.

findings.summary: The document language does not match the Indonesian interface text.
findings.evidence: html lang is en while primary labels include Jepang, Indo, Barat and LANJUTKAN MENONTON; no dir or logical-property strategy is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct primary language, mark genuinely mixed-language fragments, and use logical properties for translation-ready layout.

findings.summary: The playback flow uses deceptive forced-continuity advertising.
findings.evidence: Playing the video opens an ad, further tabs open at 10 and 15 seconds, and the only modal action labelled Continue Watching links to an ad domain.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove forced advertising actions and ensure Continue Watching performs exactly that action; label any promotion honestly and make it optional.

findings.summary: Third-party font and icon assets are disproportionate to this tiny page.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 94 percent of transferred bytes; a 108,759-byte Font Awesome font is used for one Telegram icon.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the icon font with inline SVG and self-host a minimal variable or subset font, with long-lived caching.

findings.summary: Decorative animations run continuously even when users request less motion.
findings.evidence: Six infinite shimmer/glow animations remain active under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Stop decorative loops for reduced-motion users and pause nonessential animation when the page is hidden.

taskList.title: Restore the core stream and explicit error/not-found recovery
Remove deceptive playback ads and the forced interstitial
Deploy baseline security and privacy headers
Fix robots, canonical URLs, sitemap and metadata
Remove Font Awesome and self-host/subset remaining fonts
Add preference-aware motion, color and contrast styles
Add semantic headings, readable text, focus handling and captions
Correct language metadata and logical layout properties
Use a platform transition for the remaining popup state
